---
title: "Cards"
subtitle: "A native fenced-div pattern"
description: "Build a vertical card from Quarto fenced divs, with an ordinary linked heading."
---

Askr cards use nested Quarto fenced divs. The shell has no click handler, and
the heading link supplies the card's primary navigation. Any links authored in
the body keep their own native destinations.

## Authoring syntax

Choose a heading level that fits the surrounding page outline. The `.unlisted`
class keeps the real heading out of the page table of contents; the title link
retains native link behavior.

````markdown
:::: {.askr-card}
::: {.askr-card-body}
### [Title](target.qmd) {.askr-card-title .unlisted}

Short supporting paragraph.
:::
::::
````

The outer `.askr-card` draws the card shell. `.askr-card-body` groups its
content, and `.askr-card-title` styles the author-chosen heading. No JavaScript
or whole-card link is involved.

## Migrate existing markup

Replace the legacy card classes with the namespaced classes below. Remove the
generic Bootstrap `card` and `card-body` classes rather than carrying them into
the new markup.

| Existing class | Card helper class |
| --- | --- |
| `.card.course-card` | `.askr-card` |
| `.card-body` | `.askr-card-body` |
| `.course-card-title` | `.askr-card-title` |

Keep the title as a real heading and link. The shell has no click handler; the
body is not itself a link, button, or disclosure, while links inside it remain
independent native links.

## Availability

Card status: ⏳ Unreleased on `develop`; not included in v0.11.0 or earlier.
Upgrade a consumer only after a Card-capable release is available. Then remove
only the local `.course-card` rules and retain unrelated CSS.
